change: Enable the existing 48-sample startup observer at five-second intervals for Fabric 26.1 on this diagnostic build. It records thread stacks while retaining build 253 graphics policy.
checks: The configuration observer fixture assertions passed against the candidate compiled classes. The standalone fixture classpath lacks the PS5 LWJGL adapter.
Target build, signing, package audit and SHA-256 passed.
console_status: Reproduced the Fabric 26.1 with Sodium world-entry stall on build 254. The user reported that rendering resumed in the same session.

findings: At approximately 35 to 50 seconds after Minecraft Main entry, four consecutive snapshots put the render thread inside native OpenGL draw calls. These include a Sodium chunk multi-draw and, at 45 and 50 seconds, the same vanilla particle draw stack.
At 55 seconds the render thread was in the normal frame limiter. Later snapshots show client simulation and GUI work.
The Java stacks locate the stall within native rendering. They do not distinguish synchronous pipeline compilation from a driver or GPU wait.
